text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 326 units of caspofungin acetate with a daily use of 16.1, providing 20 days on hand as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-01-12. FDA's shortage list also records Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. (US Agent eVenus Pharmaceutical Laboratories, Inc.) as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-06-30.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 20 days. Five alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no plant we could place. No clinical changes are proposed; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Fosun Pharma USA Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Gland Pharma Limited, Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC, and Sagent Pharmaceuticals; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently listed.
2. Buyer to verify manufacturing site reliability and supply continuity for each alternative supplier; requires Quality Assurance approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes; requires no additional approval.
4. Pharmacy director to review inventory allocation protocols if supply gaps emerge; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until stock falls below 14 days on hand.
